download_and_extract_archive: download a URL archive to a directory and extract it with optional MD5 verification
check_integrity: check if a file exists and optionally verify its MD5 checksum matches an expected value
calculate_md5: calculate the MD5 hash of a file using chunked reads for local or remote backends
open_maybe_compressed_file: open a file that may be gzip or xz compressed and return a readable file object
extract_archive: extract tar, tar.gz, tar.xz, tgz, zip, or gzip archives to a specified directory
